TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY JULY 16, 2025 9:30 AM
  SAN DIMAS COUNCIL CHAMBER CONFERENCE ROOM
  245 EAST BONITA AVENUE

PLEASE NOTE: Traffic Safety Committee is an Advisory Committee which is open to the public. In order to conduct the
meeting effectively and fairly, participants will be given an opportunity to discuss their concerns within a 3-minute time
allotment. This timing has been instituted to ensure everyone wishing to speak has the same opportunity. We appreciate
your understanding and cooperation with this policy.

If you have any additional questions, please contact staff at (909) 394-6240 or email at publicworks@sandimasca.gov.

 COMMITTEE MEMBERS

Shari Garwick (Director of Public Works), Steve Barragan (Engineering Manager, Public
Works Dept.), Esau Ramos (Manager, Maintenance Yard), Deputy Martinez (San Dimas Sheriff’s Department),
Detective Gasparyan (San Dimas Sheriff’s Department), Ruben Perales (Traffic Engineer), Rose Lee (BUSD Manager of
Special Assignments), Genevieve Amaro (Management Aide, Public Works Dept.)

 INTRODUCTIONS

 DISCUSSION ITEMS

07-25-01 Cataract & Second Street concerns regarding cross traffic
Request from Resident, to review vehicles traveling east and west on Second Street at Cataract Ave.

07-25-02 Arrow Hwy & Cataract concerns regarding right turn lanes onto Arrow Hwy
Request from Resident, to review right turn lanes onto Arrow Hwy and current signage.

07-25-03 Eucla Ave concerns
Request from Resident, concerned about vehicles appearing to travel along Eucla Avenue at speeds beyond the
posted speed limit and concerns regarding stop sign.

07-25-04 City Birthday Application
Request from Staff, to review TCP.

07-25-05 San Dimas High School Parada Application
Request from BUSD, to review TCP.

07-25-06 National Night Out
Request from San Dimas Sheriff’s Department, to review TCP.

 CONTINUED ITEMS
  Traffic Safety Committee Agenda
 For the Meeting of July 16, 2025  Page 2

05-25-04- Renwick and Shellman Avenue Vehicles Parking Concerns
Request from Resident, review parking concerns along Shellman Ave and Lone Hill Park field use

05-25-09 Red Curb Instalation in front of 920 N Amelia Avenue
Request from reisdent, to consider red curb installation for line of sight concern. This item was reviewed at the November
2018 meeting and July 2024 TSC meeting.

  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

  ADJOURNMENT

  Notice Regarding Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need
  assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (909) 394-6216.
  Early notification before the meeting you wish to attend will make it possible for the City to make
  reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting [28 CFR 35.102-35.104 ADA Title
  II].

Copies of documents distributed for the meeting are available in alternative formats upon request. Any writings
or documents provided to the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public
review Monday through Thursday 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. and on Fridays from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. at the Public
Works Department. In addition, most documents are posted on the City's website at www.sandimasca.gov.

Posting Statement: I declare under penalty of perjury that on July 10, 2025, I posted a true and correct copy of
this agenda on the bulletin board in the Civic Center Plaza of City Hall at 245 E. Bonita Ave., and on the City's
website www.sandimasca.gov/agendas-minutes/as required by law.

  Genevieve Amaro
July 10, 2025
  Genevieve Amaro, Management Aide
